Qworum's RDF vocabularies

To view the RDF files as human-readable HTML, install the RDF Viewer browser extension. For RDF specialists, the raw RDF files remain accessible after installing.

Ontologies

qrmm
A general-purpose ontology.
qrmd
Defines datatypes.

Prose annotations

Prose annotations are useful for translating RDF statements into human prose which is understandable by LLMs and humans.

rdf and rdfs annotations
Prose annotations for the rdf and rdfs ontologies.
foaf annotations
Prose annotations for the foaf ontology.
bio annotations
Prose annotations for the bio ontology.
rel annotations
Prose annotations for the rel ontology.

Contribute annotations on GitHub .
